HISD Select

A native <select> wrapped in the shared HISD form shell: surface background, --color-border at rest, a 2 px --color-action focus border with a --color-focus ring, and a custom chevron tinted in --color-text-muted. Native keyboard behaviour is preserved (Arrow keys navigate, Enter confirms, Escape closes). Below, every state is shown in both light and dark themes.

Light theme

data-theme="light"

Default

Choose the student's current grade.

With placeholder (focus me)

Tab here and press Enter or Space to open.

Error

This field is required.

Disabled

Locked for the current cycle.

Dark theme

data-theme="dark"

Default

Choose the student's current grade.

With placeholder (focus me)

Tab here and press Enter or Space to open.

Error

This field is required.

Disabled

Locked for the current cycle.

Copy-paste snippet

<!-- HISD Select. Requires hisd-theme.css + select.css. -->
<div class="hisd-select-field">
  <label class="hisd-select-label" for="campus">Campus</label>
  <span class="hisd-select">
    <select class="hisd-select__control" id="campus"
            aria-describedby="campus-help">
      <option value="" disabled selected hidden>Select a campus…</option>
      <option value="bellaire">Bellaire High School</option>
      <option value="lamar">Lamar High School</option>
    </select>
  </span>
  <p class="hisd-select-helper" id="campus-help">Choose your campus.</p>
</div>

<!-- Error state: add data-invalid + aria-invalid, swap helper for error. -->
<div class="hisd-select-field" data-invalid="true">
  <label class="hisd-select-label" for="lang">Home language</label>
  <span class="hisd-select">
    <select class="hisd-select__control" id="lang"
            aria-invalid="true" aria-describedby="lang-error">
      <option value="" disabled selected hidden>Select a language…</option>
      <option value="es">Spanish / Español</option>
    </select>
  </span>
  <p class="hisd-select-error" id="lang-error" role="alert">
    <span class="hisd-select-error__icon" aria-hidden="true"></span>
    This field is required.
  </p>
</div>
